home.title: Every tool your Shopify store needs, in one app
home.lead: {count} tools for conversion, trust, offers, reviews, marketing and AI. One flat price with no usage fees, and only the tools you turn on load in your store.
home.note: {days}-day free trial. Plans from {price} a month. Billing stops the moment you uninstall.
home.categoriesTitle: Tools for every part of your store
home.categoriesLead: Switch on what you need. Everything you leave off stays out of your theme.
home.speedTitle: Built to keep your store fast
home.speedLead: Store speed affects sales and search rankings, so the app is built to stay out of the way.
home.speed1Body: One small script starts after your page has finished loading. Our build fails if it ever grows past 5 KB.
home.speed2Body: Each tool lives in its own file of 10 KB or less, and only the tools you switch on are loaded.
home.speed3Body: Every tool loads on its own, so if one fails, the others keep working.
home.speed4Body: Speed Guard measures your store's mobile speed score before and after you install the app.
home.honestLead: Fake timers and made-up sales pop-ups cost trust, and consumer protection rules treat them as misleading. Our tools only show what is true.
home.honest1: Countdown Timer counts down to the real end of your sale and hides itself when the sale is over.
home.honest2: Stock Scarcity reads your real Shopify inventory.
home.honest3: Recent Sales Notifications show real orders, without names or addresses, and stay hidden until you have sales.
home.honest4: Spin the Wheel draws every slice at the chance you set, and each code expires when it says it does.
home.oneTitle: One app instead of a dozen
home.one1Body: One flat price, billed through your Shopify invoice. No usage fees.
home.one2Body: Every tool uses the same settings screens inside your Shopify admin.
home.one3Body: When two tools would do the same job, like Live Chat and Chat Button, the app tells you to pick one.
home.one4Body: Shopify removes the app from your theme and stops billing right away. Your app data is erased when Shopify asks, 48 hours later.
home.aiTitle: AI that stays inside your plan
home.aiLead: Professional includes {credits} AI credits every month for writing, photos and video. When they run out, AI tools pause until next month. You are never charged extra.
home.ai1Body: Product descriptions, alt text, product FAQs, review summaries and social posts.
home.ai2Body: A 30-day marketing plan, campaign ideas, page audits, new pages and draft products from a link.
home.ai3Body: Remove backgrounds, sharpen photos, put products in new scenes and turn photos into short videos.
home.ai4Body: Most results wait for you to check and save them, and saved changes can be undone.
home.assistantBody: Connect ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok to your store. They can read your reports and ask for changes, and nothing changes until you approve it in your Shopify admin.
home.faq1Q: Do I need to edit my theme code?
home.faq1A: No. The tools run through a Shopify app embed that you turn on once in the theme editor. Some tools can also be placed as blocks wherever you like. Nothing is pasted into your theme files.
home.faq2Q: Will it slow down my store?
home.faq2A: The loader is under 5 KB, starts after your page has loaded, and only loads the tools you turn on. Speed Guard shows your mobile speed score before and after you install.
home.faq3Q: Does the price go up if I use more?
home.faq3A: No. Each plan has one flat price with no usage fees. AI credits, emails and recordings have monthly limits. When a limit is reached, that feature pauses until it refills next month.
home.faq4A: Starter has {starter} tools for conversion, trust, offers, reviews and SEO. Professional has all {all}, adding marketing, AI tools, live chat, instant search and visitor recordings.
home.faq5A: Shopify cancels the subscription right away, so billing stops. The app leaves your theme automatically, and your app data is erased when Shopify asks us to, 48 hours after you uninstall.
home.faq6A: Visitor analytics and recordings only run for visitors who allow analytics in your cookie banner, what shoppers type is never recorded, and Shopify's privacy requests are handled automatically.
home.finalTitle: Try every tool free for {days} days
home.finalBody: Install, turn on the app embed once, and switch on the tools you want.

features.title: Features
features.lead: Beyond the {count} tools, the app gives you the parts that tie them together: reports, an offer engine, reviews, email, AI and privacy controls.
features.analyticsBody: See views, clicks, add to carts, orders and revenue for every tool over the last 30 days, plus a store report with visitors, sources, devices and top pages. Visitors are counted only when they allow analytics.
features.offersBody: Volume discounts, bundles, free gifts, buy X get Y and upsells share one Shopify discount function. Set who sees an offer and when, choose what happens when offers overlap, and split shoppers into two groups for an A/B test.
features.reviewsBody: Collect product and store reviews with photos, approve or reply to them, ask for reviews by email after an order, and import reviews from Judge.me, Loox, Shopify Product Reviews or another app with a CSV file. Ratings can show as stars in Google.
features.marketingBody: Send campaigns and four automatic emails: welcome, abandoned checkout, review request and win-back. Professional includes {emails} emails a month. Already use Klaviyo, Mailchimp or Omnisend? Connect them and new subscribers are sent there too.
features.aiBody: {count} AI tools for writing, growing and making photos and videos, all following your brand voice. Each task uses credits from your monthly allowance and stops when it runs out.
features.visibilityTitle: Get found by Google and AI assistants
features.visibilityBody: An AI visibility score checks your product data, descriptions, alt text, search fields, reviews, FAQs and whether AI crawlers can read your store, with a button to fix each one.
features.assistantsBody: Give ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok a private address for your store. They can read your reports and ask to turn tools and offers on or off or to answer reviews. Every change waits for your approval.
features.speedBody: Measure your store's mobile speed score before installing and any time after, so you can see that the app doesn't slow your store down.
features.placementBody: Widgets find the right spot on most themes by themselves. To move one, place the App widget block in the theme editor, or set a custom position for unusual themes.
features.privacyBody: Consent-aware analytics and recordings, Shopify's privacy requests handled automatically, a customer data lookup for access requests, and data erased after you uninstall.
features.sectionsBody: Build pages in the theme editor with 19 sections, like a hero banner, testimonials, an FAQ and a comparison table. They're plain HTML and CSS, so they don't slow your store down.

pricing.title: Simple pricing, no usage fees
pricing.lead: Pick a plan and get every tool in it. Prices are in US dollars and billed by Shopify.
pricing.starterSummary: Conversion, trust, offers, reviews and SEO tools.
pricing.professionalSummary: Everything in Starter, plus marketing, AI, live chat, instant search and recordings.
pricing.includesAi: {credits} AI credits a month ({trial} during the trial)
pricing.noUsage: No usage fees. Limits refill every month and features pause when one is reached.
pricing.faq1A: Yes. Both plans start with a {days}-day free trial. You can cancel during the trial by uninstalling and you won't be charged.
pricing.faq2Q: What happens when my AI credits run out?
pricing.faq2A: AI tools pause until your credits refill next month. You are never charged extra, and every other tool keeps working.
pricing.faq3A: Yes. Open Plans in the app and pick the other plan at any time. Shopify takes care of the billing change.
pricing.faq4A: Uninstall the app from your Shopify admin. Shopify cancels the subscription at once, so billing stops the moment you uninstall.
pricing.faq5A: Prices are in US dollars before any taxes Shopify adds for your region. The charge appears on your regular Shopify invoice.
